correctness.rationale: The structural upper bound is reconstructed from primitive cyclic necklaces: there are 54 primitive binary length-six words, hence nine necklaces, and a comma-free code contains at most one representative from each. The embedded verifier exhausts all compatible one-representative choices, directly rechecks every resulting code against all ordered pairs and shifts, finds \(1{,}972\) maxima, and independently recomputes the four-element symmetry action and \(493\) size-four orbits. Replay output and the deterministic census hash match the stated values.

value.rationale: The old optimum \(W_6(2)=9\) leaves its equality structure completely undetermined. Counting every extremizer and showing that all 493 complement/reversal classes have trivial stabilizer supplies a natural complete classification at a historically tabulated even-length parameter. This is not a recomputation of the maximum alone: the exact equality census and symmetry structure answer a distinct finite classification question useful for testing constructions and understanding how nonunique attainment of the necklace bound occurs.
